introduction: Discover the ports, meet their contacts and follow nineteen independent commissions: local supplies, overseas proof and exact mixed collections. Six supplier and equipment services stay separate. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Canderthal, Fenaline and Thur'Gurax have separate loaded land approaches from the Surface Realm. Visiting one discovers this shared area, but other contacts remain hidden until encountered. No ship ownership or sailing receipt is required for the native deliveries.

Start with dock supply recovery and the seafood kitchens. Chundel and Grimashk pay different prices for normal crates; Grimashk also accepts old reinforced crates as one recovery alternative. Voshen and Martinek each need six of their own exact seafood kind.

Pol sells an ordinary fishing pole separately from his refunded briefing. His final lure request consumes five shells and five fire glands, pays cash and XP, and does not require his note or award Fishfetcher. Optional current supplies and earlier history do not add achievements.

Crendethyl wants the engraved stein equipped by the huge bartender in Canderthal. Elthindeal wants the Canderthal ale cask from Gringash's cellar. Carry their actual proofs between the ports; tavern dialogue and visits provide guidance without enforced prior stages.

The turtle, pyrolisk, viper, panther, samurai, hydralisk and bandit sources disperse into distinct mainland regions. Their caps, worn proof and current roaming locations need active qualification. One pyrolisk branch is unloaded and one viper destination is ocean. Supplied materials remain valid.

Gringash and Kruth'Urgur want the same tinker map for different independent purposes and payments. Gelden wants a Sarmiz obsidian and steel totem; Shaenae wants the aged ring from a foreign bone pile; Frull wants a Werrun cigar box. The delivery receipt belongs to this port area even when its source is elsewhere.

Krintis, Ayden and Vrash compete for venom, glands or panther teeth. Trismerk needs five jade katanas; Austugus needs five hydralisk glands. Cairme's implemented recipe needs four shivs and the exact tundra rations despite a conflicting six-shiv line. These research and military commissions do not implement poison, antidote, siege or arsenal state.

Bestile needs six distinct potion kinds, one each. The troll in Thur'Gurax stocks his brown potion locally as well as all three Bronak materials. Exact supplies can come from shops, alternate sources or other players; their possession does not prove first personal acquisition or visiting every named shop.

Bronak's three totems each require one exact material and fifty platinum. His outputs differ from Gelden's proof. The refunded briefing, two seafood purchases and three totem recipes remain support services with guarded coin settlement.

Closed port gates are unkeyed. The barracks east door is reset locked with key zero; ordinary lock-picking and other valid access need qualification. A hidden cellar staircase connects to a foreign gambling room. Loaded sea edges use ocean movement; three other legacy port exits are unloaded and need deliberate repair.

Worshipping the garden statue and touching the storm altar use ordinary teleport objects with walking return routes. The moonwell enters Shaledrieth. These actions, teachers suggested by prose, inns, ship construction and crew hiring have no new quest milestones without accepted event evidence. Paid ship services also need coordinated accounting settlement.

Quest rewards preserve actual cash, items, declared XP and recipient retirement. Native XP is subject to actor and companion caps. Gifts can prepare a valid turn-in without recording personal hunting, fishing, sailing, faction standing, learned keywords or a whole campaign.

contacts.description: Snapjaw turtles are loaded through a dispersal room into the lowland marshes of Skulldrach Lake. Their ordinary shells share a cap of fifteen; captive turtles on the Crimson Fulgur provide another reviewed source. Five supplied shells also qualify.

contacts.name: a tundra panther

contacts.name: a highland samurai
contacts.description: Highland samurai disperse into the Lush Fields of the Jade Empire and equip jade katanas, sharing a cap of eight. Other samurai swords are different objects. Five supplied katanas qualify without recording five personal kills or weakening a world defense state.

contacts.name: a green hydralisk

contacts.name: a human bandit
contacts.description: Human bandits disperse into mainland grassy pastures and nearby light forest, carrying shivs with a shared cap of eleven. Carry four shivs for the actual recipe. Cairme also says six in one sentence; that is a clue conflict, not the accepted count.

stories.title: Pol's lure materials
stories.summary: Pol needs five snapjaw shells and five pyrolisk fire glands for a lure experiment. Return ten actual materials together for three hundred platinum and a native XP award. His earlier refunded deposit and note are optional history; the final contract requires neither and gives no Fishfetcher pole.

steps.text: Optional history: receive Pol's briefing and refunded deposit
steps.hint: The earlier paid exchange returns the same 300,000 copper and gives a note; its settlement remains unavailable with active accounting. It does not buy a pole or establish a mandatory deposit entitlement.
Pol gives this note with the refunded deposit. He asks for it in prose, but the final recipe does not accept or consume it. A supplied note is current possession, without proving that briefing.

Snapjaw turtles are loaded through a dispersal room into the lowland marshes of Skulldrach Lake. Their ordinary shells share a cap of fifteen; captive turtles on the Crimson Fulgur provide another reviewed source. Five supplied shells also qualify.

Stonescale pyrolisks disperse into the Great Lava Fields of the Damned. Their fire glands share a cap of nineteen, with some held and others carried. One dispersal branch is unloaded and needs correction. Captive pyrolisks provide another source. Pol and Ayden compete for the glands.

Pol starts in his pole shop in Canderthal. Acceptance declares 125,000 XP, subject to native caps, pays 300,000 copper and retires his appearance. A supplied collection qualifies without an earlier deposit, note, personal hunting or sailing history.

stories.title: Voshen's six pike
stories.summary: The anxious chef needs six large pike for his kitchen. Deliver six together for fifty platinum and a native XP award. Freshness, a personal catch and the complimentary fillet promised in his speech are not implemented outcomes.

steps.hint: Fishing can produce this exact pike when you have fishing skill, an eligible pole in top-level carrying and a supported water room. A roaming seafood merchant also offers one for five platinum, pending supported paid settlement. Supplied pike qualify; freshness and personal catching are not native requirements.
Find Voshen at the seafood kitchen behind the Fisherman's Hutch. Acceptance declares 40,000 XP, pays 50,000 copper and retires him; it creates no fillet object.

stories.title: Crendethyl's old stein
stories.summary: The elven glassblower asks for the engraved stein he left in Canderthal. Retrieve or obtain the exact glass stein and return it to him in Fenaline for twenty-four platinum and a native XP award.

steps.hint: The huge bartender in the Fisherman's Hutch holds Crendethyl's engraved glass stein as a weapon. Recover or obtain that exact object, then carry it for delivery. Similar cups and the bartender's ambient wiping text do not substitute or record a personal recovery.

Crendethyl starts at Martinek's Clam House in Fenaline; the huge bartender in Canderthal is the source. Acceptance pays 24,000 copper, declares 166,000 XP and retires Crendethyl. Asking hello explains the request without granting keyword achievements.

stories.title: Gringash's city map
stories.summary: Gringash wants a map of Venan'Trut for his cousin's proposed bar. Bring the tinker map for his independent payment and XP. The accepted delivery does not open a bar, establish a Kimordril endpoint or require sailing.

steps.hint: The tinker at the Shoppe of the Traveling People in Venan'Trut stocks this exact map. Gringash and Kruth'Urgur accept it independently for different rewards. A gift or land route is valid; neither contract requires a personal shop purchase or sailing receipt.
Find Gringash in his Canderthal bar. Acceptance pays 65,656 copper, declares 81,000 XP and retires him. Kruth'Urgur pays differently for a separate delivery of the same map.

stories.title: Krintis's poison reagents
stories.summary: Bring three sand viper venom sacs and three tundra panther teeth for Krintis's poison research. Six exact objects earn his payment and XP; the contract gives no finished poison.

steps.hint: Sand vipers disperse mostly into the Calimshan Desert; a loaded fourth destination is ocean rather than sand and needs source review. Their venom sacs share a cap of twenty. Krintis and Ayden compete for these supplies; gifts also qualify.

Tundra panthers disperse into the partially frozen IceCrag grasslands and forest. Their teeth are equipped as weapons and share a cap of twenty-two. Captive panthers provide another source. Krintis and Vrash compete for the same exact teeth.
Krintis starts in the wine cellar below Gringash. Acceptance pays 210,000 copper, declares 100,000 XP and retires him. Ayden and Vrash compete for parts of these supplies.

stories.title: Gelden's elemental study
stories.summary: Gelden seeks an obsidian and steel totem from Sarmiz'Duul to study elemental power. Deliver the exact totem for a payment and XP. His flight as a hawk is success prose and retirement, without a recorded transformation or travel stage.

steps.hint: A half-orc shaman in Sarmiz'Duul holds the obsidian and steel totem, with cap one. Bronak's elemental, spirit and chimera totems are three different objects and cannot substitute. A supplied exact totem qualifies.
Find Gelden at the end of the northern pier in Canderthal. Acceptance pays 150,000 copper, declares 65,000 XP and retires him. Bronak's different paid totems do not complete this study.

stories.title: Chundel's port crates
stories.summary: Recover a normal supply crate and return it to Chundel for two gold. This repeatable port supply request remains separate from Grimashk's better-paying crate recovery in Thur'Gurax.

steps.hint: Normal supply crates are ordinary ground stock around the ports, with a shared local cap of forty-two and additional foreign placements. Chundel and Grimashk are separate recipients paying different amounts. A prior crate delivery does not replace a currently carried crate.
Chundel starts on the dock pathway in Canderthal. Each accepted normal crate pays 200 copper and he remains. A Grimashk receipt cannot complete this request.

stories.title: Elthindeal's Canderthal ale
stories.summary: Elthindeal wants to sample a cask of Canderthal ale. Bring the exact cask to Fenaline for forty-five platinum and a native XP award. Tavern visits and other drinks are guidance rather than required prior stages.

steps.hint: A cask of Canderthal ale is ground stock in the wine cellar below Gringash's bar, with cap one. Carry it to Elthindeal at the Wind's Breath Inn in Fenaline. Drinking local ale or acquiring another cask does not complete the accepted return.
Find Elthindeal at the Wind's Breath Inn. Acceptance pays 45,000 copper, declares 55,000 XP and retires her. The cask comes from the Canderthal wine cellar.

stories.title: Trismerk's five katanas
stories.summary: Trismerk asks for five jade katanas from the highland samurai. Deliver five exact weapons together for payment and XP. His military objective is explained as lore; the receipt does not establish five personal kills or altered defenses.

steps.hint: Highland samurai disperse into the Lush Fields of the Jade Empire and equip jade katanas, sharing a cap of eight. Other samurai swords are different objects. Five supplied katanas qualify without recording five personal kills or weakening a world defense state.
Trismerk starts in the Wind's Breath dining chamber in Fenaline. Acceptance pays 135,000 copper, declares 80,000 XP and retires him.

stories.title: Austugus's hydralisk research
stories.summary: Collect five green hydralisk gas glands for Austugus's proposed poison treatment. The delivery earns payment and XP without giving an antidote, curing a player or finishing an alchemy campaign.

steps.hint: Green hydralisks disperse into the DarkPeak valley and hills, carrying gas glands with a shared cap of seventeen. Captive hydralisks provide another reviewed source. Five actual glands are needed; the proposed antidote is lore rather than an additional reward.
Austugus starts on a grassy road in Fenaline and can roam. Acceptance pays 240,000 copper, declares 110,000 XP and retires him; his initial room is a lead rather than a live location.

stories.title: Martinek's six clams
stories.summary: Martinek needs six small clams for his hungry customers. Deliver six together for fifty platinum and a native XP award. A personal fishing trip and restaurant-restoration state are not required.

steps.hint: Fishing can produce this exact small clam. A roaming seafood merchant also offers one for five platinum, pending supported paid settlement. Six separate clams must be carried together; supplied clams qualify without personal fishing or freshness history.
Find Martinek in his Fenaline clam house. Acceptance pays 50,000 copper, declares 45,000 XP and retires him. Supplied clams reach the same terminal.

stories.title: Shaenae's aged ring
stories.summary: Shaenae remembers a silver ring in a distant bone yard. Return the exact aged silver ring for two hundred platinum and a native XP award. Her departure into the moonwell is success prose rather than a recorded transformation or your required portal journey.

steps.hint: The aged silver ring is nested in the bone pile at the Boneheap in the Behemoth Herders area, with cap one. Another bone pile holds a stud instead. Remove the actual ring into top-level carrying; a different silver ring or stud cannot replace it.
Shaenae starts at Fenaline's moonwell. Acceptance pays 200,000 copper, declares 155,000 XP and retires her. The bone-pile ring is different from other silver jewelry.

stories.title: Ayden's horde reagents
stories.summary: Ayden wants three pyrolisk fire glands and three sand viper venom sacs for his poison project. Deliver both exact groups together for payment and XP; no poison item or horde arsenal state follows.

steps.hint: Stonescale pyrolisks disperse into the Great Lava Fields of the Damned. Their fire glands share a cap of nineteen, with some held and others carried. One dispersal branch is unloaded and needs correction. Captive pyrolisks provide another source. Pol and Ayden compete for the glands.

Sand vipers disperse mostly into the Calimshan Desert; a loaded fourth destination is ocean rather than sand and needs source review. Their venom sacs share a cap of twenty. Krintis and Ayden compete for these supplies; gifts also qualify.
Ayden starts atop the Thur'Gurax watchtower. Acceptance pays 160,000 copper, declares 90,000 XP and retires him. Pol and Krintis compete for these same materials.

stories.title: Kruth'Urgur's siege map
stories.summary: Bring Kruth'Urgur a map of Venan'Trut for his siege planning. This is his own accepted delivery, with a different reward from Gringash. It does not establish a siege, faction enlistment or personal desert travel.

steps.hint: The tinker at the Shoppe of the Traveling People in Venan'Trut stocks this exact map. Gringash and Kruth'Urgur accept it independently for different rewards. A gift or land route is valid; neither contract requires a personal shop purchase or sailing receipt.
Kruth'Urgur starts in Banner Square in Thur'Gurax. Acceptance pays 35,000 copper, declares 35,000 XP and retires him. Gringash's earlier map receipt cannot substitute.

stories.title: Vrash's mace materials
stories.summary: Vrash requests three wicked looking maces and three tundra panther teeth for proposed spiked prototypes. Deliver the six exact materials for payment and XP; the contract does not give a new mace or upgrade the troops.

steps.hint: Wemic warriors equip the wicked looking mace at several village paths, sharing a cap of six. Three separate maces are required alongside three exact panther teeth. Similar maces and possession of a proposed finished weapon do not replace the recipe.

Tundra panthers disperse into the partially frozen IceCrag grasslands and forest. Their teeth are equipped as weapons and share a cap of twenty-two. Captive panthers provide another source. Krintis and Vrash compete for the same exact teeth.

Vrash starts in the Thur'Gurax barracks office. Acceptance pays 245,000 copper, declares 90,000 XP and retires him. The eastern barracks door is reset locked with no matching key; qualify ordinary lock-picking or other valid access before promising this route.

stories.title: Cairme's shivs and rations
stories.summary: Bring four bandit shivs and the exact tundra iron rations to Cairme. His dialogue conflicts between four and six; the accepted recipe needs four. Supplied rations qualify without the particular merchant purchase he suggests.

steps.hint: Human bandits disperse into mainland grassy pastures and nearby light forest, carrying shivs with a shared cap of eleven. Carry four shivs for the actual recipe. Cairme also says six in one sentence; that is a clue conflict, not the accepted count.

The barbarian-human halfbreed stocks these exact iron rations at a small tundra general store. Other legitimate sources and gifts also qualify. Ordinary port iron rations are another object kind and cannot substitute; no specific merchant purchase receipt is required.

Cairme starts in his Thur'Gurax tavern. Acceptance pays 160,000 copper, declares 105,000 XP and retires him. Ordinary port rations are another object kind; extra shivs cannot replace the right rations.

stories.title: Grimashk's crate recovery
stories.summary: Return either a normal supply crate for two gold and five silver, or an old reinforced supply crate for eight gold, four silver and five copper. These are two exact price alternatives within one recovery request; Chundel's separate delivery remains independent.

steps.text: Carry one normal or old reinforced supply crate
steps.hint: Normal supply crates are ordinary ground stock around the ports, with a shared local cap of forty-two and additional foreign placements. Chundel and Grimashk are separate recipients paying different amounts. A prior crate delivery does not replace a currently carried crate. Old reinforced supply crates are ground stock in Cairme's wine cellar, with local cap two; additional foreign placements exist. Grimashk pays a different price for this exact kind. Normal and reinforced crates are alternatives within his recovery request.

Grimashk starts at the end of a passenger pier in Thur'Gurax. A normal crate pays 250 copper; an old reinforced crate pays 845 copper. He remains after either acceptance. Each underlying receipt stays separate, while the story contributes one achievement and potential daily unit.

stories.title: Frull's Werrun cigars
stories.summary: Frull asks for a box of Werrun cigars. Deliver the exact box for his cash reward; the receipt records his commission without requiring a personal voyage or proving how the cigars were acquired.

steps.hint: A box of Werrun cigars is ordinary ground stock in its bar storage room, with cap one; a rare foreign placement also exists. The contract accepts the exact box without requiring personal sailing, theft or a merchant purchase.
Frull starts in Banner Square in Thur'Gurax and can roam. Acceptance pays 66,666 copper and retires him. No XP or new item is declared.

stories.title: Bestile's six potions
stories.summary: Bestile wants six distinct potions: cyan, pitch black, steel grey, purple, sparkling and bubbling brown. Bring one of each for payment, XP and a mixed potion. He retires after acceptance; the Hulk described in his speech is not a new transformed mobile or a separate achievement.

steps.hint: The thick cyan potion is stocked by the graveside mystic in Bloodstone, with additional foreign stock. Its identified label may change, while the exact object kind remains the same.
The pitch black potion is stocked by Severne in Sarmiz'Duul, with additional foreign stock. Extra cyan, brown or ordinary black potions cannot replace this exact kind.
The steel grey potion is stocked by Chukth at the underground market of Ghore, with additional foreign stock. A gift or alternate legitimate source qualifies without that shop receipt.
The purple potion is stocked by Flakun at the Gruneegth Drug Store, with additional foreign stock. Keep it available for delivery rather than consuming it.
The sparkling potion is stocked by Tirila at the Shop of Enchantment in Torrhan, with additional foreign stock. This is one of six distinct required potion kinds.
The bubbling brown potion is stocked by the troll in the Witchdoctor's Hut here in Thur'Gurax as well as by foreign sources. Bestile's Shadowclave clue does not enforce a mandatory journey there.

Find Bestile in the Gutted Githzerai dining area. Acceptance pays 666,666 copper, declares 100,000 XP, grants the mixed potion and retires him. Bought or supplied exact ingredients qualify; six personal shop visits and drinking the reward are not required.

stories.title: Pol's refunded briefing service
stories.summary: Pol takes three hundred platinum, immediately returns the same amount and gives his note. This support exchange neither buys Fishfetcher nor creates an extra achievement or daily. Its coin settlement is unavailable with active accounting.

steps.hint: Find Pol in the Canderthal pole shop. His final shell-and-gland recipe is independent of this receipt and does not consume the note.

stories.title: Roaming clam merchant service
stories.summary: A roaming seafood merchant offers one clam for five platinum, then departs. This paid supplier awards no quest achievement or daily; its coin settlement is unavailable with active accounting.

steps.hint: The purchase costs 5,000 copper and grants the exact clam. Buying or being handed it can prepare the chef's separate six-item delivery without completing it.

stories.title: Roaming pike merchant service
stories.summary: A roaming seafood merchant offers one pike for five platinum, then departs. This paid supplier awards no quest achievement or daily; its coin settlement is unavailable with active accounting.

steps.hint: The purchase costs 5,000 copper and grants the exact pike. Buying or being handed it can prepare the chef's separate six-item delivery without completing it.

stories.title: Bronak's chimera totem service
stories.summary: Bronak takes the exact firwood bear and fifty platinum for a chimera totem. This paid equipment service adds no achievement or daily and remains guarded pending supported material-and-fee settlement.

steps.hint: The troll in the Witchdoctor's Hut stocks the firwood bear. Bronak needs this exact material and fifty platinum for a chimera totem; an obsidian figurine or quartz cannot substitute.
Find Bronak in the Witchdoctor's loft in Thur'Gurax. The troll downstairs stocks the material. Gelden requires a different obsidian and steel totem; Bronak's output cannot complete his study.

stories.title: Bronak's spirit totem service
stories.summary: Bronak takes the exact quartz and fifty platinum for a spirit totem. This paid equipment service adds no achievement or daily and remains guarded pending supported material-and-fee settlement.

steps.hint: The troll in the Witchdoctor's Hut stocks quartz. Bronak needs this exact material and fifty platinum for a spirit totem; other stones and his other totems cannot substitute.
Find Bronak in the Witchdoctor's loft in Thur'Gurax. The troll downstairs stocks the material. Gelden requires a different obsidian and steel totem; Bronak's output cannot complete his study.

stories.title: Bronak's elemental totem service
stories.summary: Bronak takes the exact obsidian figurine and fifty platinum for a elemental totem. This paid equipment service adds no achievement or daily and remains guarded pending supported material-and-fee settlement.

steps.hint: The troll in the Witchdoctor's Hut stocks the obsidian figurine. Bronak needs this exact material and fifty platinum for an elemental totem; the Sarmiz totem requested by Gelden is different.
Find Bronak in the Witchdoctor's loft in Thur'Gurax. The troll downstairs stocks the material. Gelden requires a different obsidian and steel totem; Bronak's output cannot complete his study.
